# Classic FM

> > The UK's most popular classical music radio station, featuring composer guides, radio shows, and classical music news covering composers from Bach and Mozart to contemporary artists like Ludovico Einaudi.

Classic FM provides comprehensive resources on classical composers, instruments, and musical periods, alongside its radio programming featuring presenters like Chi-chi Nwanoku and Debbie Wiseman. The site serves as both a broadcast platform and educational resource for classical music enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
- Johann Sebastian Bach
- Ludwig van Beethoven
- Henry Purcell
- Frédéric Chopin
- Opera and vocal music
- Baroque music
- Film music and soundtracks
- Chineke! Foundation
- Samuel Coleridge-Taylor
- Ludovico Einaudi
- Don Giovanni
- Dido and Aeneas
- Classical music education
- Radio broadcasting

## Radio Shows & Presenters

- [Chi-chi's Classical Champions](https://www.classicfm.com/radio/shows-presenters/chi-chis-classical-champions): Radio show hosted by Chi-chi Nwanoku celebrating diverse classical music
- [Sounds and Sweet Airs with Debbie Wiseman](https://www.classicfm.com/radio/shows-presenters/sounds-and-sweet-airs-debbie-wiseman): Radio show celebrating female composers with Debbie Wiseman
- [Darren Henley](https://www.classicfm.com/radio/shows-presenters/darren-henley): Presenter profile: Darren Henley hosts The Story of Decca series
- [Ritula Shah](https://www.classicfm.com/radio/shows-presenters/ritula-shah): Presenter profile: Ritula Shah hosts evening Calm Classics show
- [Hannah Scott-Joynt](https://www.classicfm.com/radio/shows-presenters/hannah-scott-joynt): Presenter profile: Hannah Scott-Joynt covers Relaxing Evenings

## Composer Biographies & Profiles

- [Henry Purcell](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/purcell): Henry Purcell biography: Baroque composer and Westminster Abbey organist
- [Ludovico Einaudi](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/einaudi): Ludovico Einaudi biography: Italian minimalist piano composer
- [John Barry - Music](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/barry/music): John Barry's film scores including James Bond and Lion In Winter

## Composer Guides & Resources

- [Mozart - Recently Added Guides](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/mozart/guides/recently-added): Latest guides on Mozart's life, works, and Requiem compositions
- [Purcell Guides](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/purcell/guides): Henry Purcell composer guides including Dido and Aeneas opera
- [Aaron Copland Guides](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/copland/guides): Aaron Copland guides covering Appalachian Spring and American works

## Classical Music News & Updates

- [Rachmaninov News](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/rachmaninov/news): Latest Rachmaninov news, recordings, and concert announcements
- [Schubert News](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/schubert/news): Schubert news covering Unfinished Symphony and Winterreise performances
- [Bach News](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/bach/news): J.S. Bach news, performances, and classical music updates
- [Opera News](https://www.classicfm.com/discover-music/periods-genres/opera/news): Opera news featuring sopranos, Puccini, and vocal performances

## Instruments & Performance

- [Oboe Features](https://www.classicfm.com/discover-music/instruments/oboe/features): Articles about oboe instrument, musicians, and performance tips
- [Viola Features](https://www.classicfm.com/discover-music/instruments/viola/features): Viola instrument articles featuring musicians and performances

## Optional

- [Monteverdi Album Reviews](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/monteverdi/album-reviews): Monteverdi album reviews including Vespers recordings
- [Anthony Hopkins Pictures](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/sir-anthony-hopkins/pictures): Photo gallery of Sir Anthony Hopkins as composer and musician
- [Howard Shore Pictures](https://www.classicfm.com/composers/shore/pictures): Howard Shore photo gallery: Lord of the Rings composer images
